title.en: Attentive care for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients consistently report that their pets are treated with immense affection and individualized care during daycare and boarding stays. Pet parents describe dogs arriving excitedly for playgroups and returning home relaxed and happily tired. Multiple cat owners also praise the calm, separate cat suites, noting that their felines adapted smoothly without distress.

Reviewers frequently praise the facility staff for their warm communication, thorough assessments, and attentive supervision. Pet owners note that caregivers accommodate specific dietary routines and behavioral requirements with ease. Clients express complete trust in the team, emphasizing that staff members treat visiting animals like members of their own families.

Pet guardians appreciate receiving proactive notifications, photographs, and video clips while away on vacation or at work. Multiple reviewers highlight the convenience of checking daily video streams on YouTube and Instagram to observe their pets playing. These transparent updates give traveling owners continuous peace of mind regarding their animals' happiness.

q.en: Does Jet Pet Resort Olympic Village accommodate cats?

a.en: Yes, the facility features dedicated, quiet cat boarding suites separate from canine play areas.

q.en: Do pet parents receive photos or videos during boarding?

a.en: Yes, staff provide regular photo notifications, Instagram updates, and daily video streams of group playtime.

q.en: Is an assessment required before a pet starts daycare?

a.en: Yes, the team performs a comprehensive introductory assessment to evaluate dog temperament and group suitability.

q.en: Can staff handle special dietary needs or senior pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that caregivers follow personalized feeding instructions and accommodate senior pets with extra care.
